This is a new Jensen Interceptor! And it’s not a restomod, but rather a new-from-the-ground-up super-GT. This particular car is the Jensen Interceptor GTX, a one-off with a 6.8-litre V8 supercharged to 960hp, but it’s designed to do all the test and development work before spawning a new road-going Interceptor GT and Interceptor GTR.
